title: 第11章 初显猫武士的诞生上第12章 初显猫武士的诞生下
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
石屋内弥漫着比屋外猫薄荷浓郁百倍的奇异清香，那是【灵兽启智丹】的气息。
翠绿的丹药在林墨掌心氤氲着柔和的微光，仿佛凝聚了森林草木最精粹的生机与诱惑。
铁爪虎斑猫的暗金色瞳孔骤然收缩，如同两簇被点燃的幽火。
源自血脉深处的渴望瞬间被引爆，几乎要烧穿它磐石般的意志！
粗壮的四肢因极力克制而微微颤抖，喉咙里滚动着压抑到极致的低沉呼噜，如同地底奔涌的岩浆。
但它巨大的身躯依旧稳稳扎根原地，只有微微前倾的姿态，暴露着灵魂深处那场惊涛骇浪。
林墨直视着那双因渴望而灼热的暗金眼眸，一字一句，清晰郑重：
“喵嗷…呜…喵喵喵。”
（铁爪，吃下它。
它会带来痛苦，但痛苦之后，是更锋利的爪牙，更迅捷的速度，更强大的力量，还有…更聪明的头脑！
）他指向屋外喧嚣的狂欢声浪，“喵嗷嗷。”
（我需要你的力量！
守护它们，守护我们的灵田，守护我们的猫薄荷！
）最后，指尖落回那枚翠绿的丹药，“喵？”
（你，愿意承受吗？）
屋外的喧嚣——猫群打滚的噗噗声、兴奋的嗷嗷叫、迷离的呼噜声浪，清晰地穿透薄壁。
铁爪的目光随着林墨的手指移动，从紧闭的门扉，到脚下这片被它日夜守护的土地，最终，牢牢钉在丹药上。
暗金色的瞳孔里，守护同类的本能、对力量的渴望、对未知痛苦的警惕激烈交锋。
片刻死寂般的挣扎后，所有波澜归于沉寂，沉淀为一种山岳般的决绝。
它抬起头，深深凝视林墨，那目光纯粹、坚定，胜过千言万语的信诺。

它低下头颅，带着近乎虔诚的庄重，伸出粗糙温热的舌头，轻轻舔舐向林墨掌心的丹药。
舌尖触及翠绿丹丸的刹那——
**轰！
**
没有声音，却仿佛有惊雷在林墨脑中炸开！
一股浓郁到化不开的淡金色气流，如同沉寂万载的火山骤然喷发，毫无征兆地从铁爪虎斑猫的每一根毛发、每一个毛孔中狂涌而出！
气流瞬间将它庞大的身躯彻底吞没！
金光刺目，将昏暗石屋映照得如同熔炉！
铁爪虎斑猫连一声嘶吼都未能发出，整个身体便如同被无形巨锤狠狠砸中，猛地向后弓起，四肢僵直，爪子深深抠进地面岩石，发出令人牙酸的摩擦声！
“嗷——呜——！”
痛苦终于撕裂了它的喉咙，爆发出一声不似猫嚎、更接近猛兽濒死的凄厉咆哮！
淡金色的气旋疯狂旋转，拉扯、撕扯着它身体内外的每一寸！
**噼啪！
喀啦啦！
**
content_en:
The stone house is filled with a strange fragrance that is a hundred times stronger than the catnip outside. It is the smell of [Spiritual Beast Enlightenment Pill].
The emerald green elixir shimmered softly in Lin Mo's palm, as if it condensed the most essential vitality and temptation of the forest vegetation.
The dark golden pupils of the iron-clawed tabby cat suddenly shrank, like two clusters of ignited ghost fires.
The desire originating from the depths of the bloodline was instantly detonated, almost burning through its rock-like will!
The thick limbs trembled slightly due to the exertion of restraint, and an extremely suppressed low grunt rolled in his throat, like magma rushing underground.
But its huge body is still firmly rooted in place, with only a slight forward posture, exposing the turbulent waves deep in its soul.
Lin Mo looked directly into those dark golden eyes that were burning with desire, and spoke clearly and solemnly every word:
"Meow...ow...meow, meow, meow."
(Iron Claw, eat it.
It will bring pain, but after the pain, there will be sharper claws, faster speed, more powerful strength, and... a smarter mind!
) He pointed to the noisy carnival outside the house and said, "Meow ow."
(I need your strength!
Protect them, protect our spiritual fields, protect our catnip!
) Finally, the fingertips returned to the emerald green pill, "Meow?"
(Are you willing to bear it?)
The noise outside the house - the squeaking sounds of cats rolling around, excited howls, and blurred purring waves - clearly penetrated the thin wall.
Iron Claw's gaze followed Lin Mo's fingers, from the closed door to the land under his feet that it guarded day and night, and finally, it was firmly nailed to the elixir.
In the dark golden pupils, the instinct to protect the same kind, the desire for power, and the vigilance against unknown pain fiercely compete.
After a moment of deathly struggle, all the waves returned to silence, settling into a mountain-like determination.
It raised its head and stared deeply at Lin Mo. Its pure and firm gaze was worth more than a thousand words of faith.
It lowered its head, with an almost pious solemnity, stretched out its rough and warm tongue, and gently licked the elixir in Lin Mo's palm.
The moment the tip of the tongue touches the green pill——
**Boom!
**
There was no sound, but thunder seemed to explode in Lin Mo's mind!
A stream of light golden air that was so rich that it could not be dissolved was like a sudden eruption of a volcano that had been silent for thousands of years, rushing out from every hair and pore of the iron-clawed tabby cat without any warning!
The air current completely engulfed its huge body in an instant!
The golden light was dazzling, reflecting the dim stone house like a furnace!
The iron-clawed tabby cat couldn't even utter a roar. It felt as if its entire body had been hit hard by an invisible giant hammer. It suddenly arched back, its limbs stiffened, and its claws dug deeply into the rocks on the ground, making a tooth-piercing friction sound!
"Aww-wow-!"
The pain finally tore its throat, and it burst out with a shrill roar that was not like a cat's howl, but closer to the death of a beast!
The pale golden cyclone rotated crazily, pulling and tearing every inch of its body inside and outside!
**Crack!
Click!
**
